This repository is Compass, a local AI workflow coach (Python 3.9+ standard library and vanilla JS; no new dependencies).
- Tests: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v`. Eval: `python -m compass eval` (keep at or above 80%).
- Never weaken these: k-anonymity, Host/Origin checks, runner argument validation and approval, the scanner hash check, workspace boundaries, the ban on ranking people.
- Missing evidence is "not checked", never "passed". Synthetic data only; no company names or real data.
- Plan first, keep changes small, and show test output as evidence. Hand-off tasks: docs/handoff/copilot.md. Full conventions: AGENTS.md.
